'''Sergey Vladimirovich Bolotin''' (Сергей Владимирович Болотин, born 1 December 1954 in Moscow) is a Russian mathematician, specializing in [[dynamical systems]] of [[classical mechanics]].<ref name=mathnet>{{cite web|title=Bolotin, Sergey Vladimirovich (with list of publications)|website=mathnet.ru|url=http://www.mathnet.ru/eng/person22874}}</ref>

==Biography==
Bolotin graduated in 1976 from the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of [[Moscow State University]]. There he received in 1981 his [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree (PhD)<ref name=letopis>{{cite web|url=https://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/2179|website=Летопись Московского университета (Annals of Moscow State University|title=Болотин Сергей Владимирович}}</ref> with thesis Либрационные движения обратимых механических систем ([[Libration]]al motions of reversible mechanical systems). He received in 1998<ref name=mathnet/> his Russian [[Doctor of Sciences]] degree (habilitation) with thesis Двоякоасимптотические траектории и условия интегрируемости гамильтоновых систем<ref>{{cite journal|title=Двоякоасимптотические траектории и условия интегрируемости гамильтоновых систем|website=fizmathim.com|date=1997 |url=https://fizmathim.com/dvoyakosimptoticheskie-traektorii-i-usloviya-integriruemosti-gamiltonovyh-sistem}}</ref> (Double-asymptotic trajectories and [[integrable system|integrability]] conditions for [[Hamiltonian mechanics|Hamiltonian systems]]).

Since 1998 Bolotin is a professor in the Department of Theoretical Mechanics, Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics, Moscow State University.<ref name=letopis/> He is now the head of the Mechanics Department of the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://istina.msu.ru/workers/7949950/|title=Болотин Сергей Владимирович|publisher=istina.msu.ru}}</ref> His research deals with dynamical systems of classical mechanics, Hamiltonian systems, and [[variational methods]].<ref name=mathnet/> He has supervised four PhD (Candidate of Sciences) students. He is the author or coauthor of over 75 scientific publications, including a textbook on [[theoretical mechanics]] (2010).<ref name=letopis/> He has served on the editorial board of the journal ''Regular and Chaotic Dynamics''.

In 1994 he was an invited speaker with talk ''Invariant Sets of Hamiltonian Systems and Variational Methods'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Zurich.<ref name="Bolotin1995">{{cite book|last1=Bolotin|first1=Sergey V.|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, 1994 Zürich|publisher=Birkhäuser, Basel|chapter=Invariant Sets of Hamiltonian Systems and Variational Methods|year=1995|pages=1169–1178|doi=10.1007/978-3-0348-9078-6_110|isbn=978-3-0348-9897-3 }}</ref> In 2016 he was elected a corresponding member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=letopis/>

As a hobby, Bolotin sails in Olympic class [[Finn (dinghy)|Finn dinghies]].<ref>[https://www.finnclass.ru/regatta2020/384/Results Результаты (Results)]. Регата памяти Евгения Истомина . 9 августа 2020 года. Официальный сайт Российской ассоциации класса "Финн". Болотин Сергей ... (Regatta in memory of Yevgeny Istomin. 9 August 2020. The official site of the Russian Finn Class Association. Bolotin Sergey ... )</ref>

His brother Yuri Vladimirovich Bolotin (born December 1, 1954) is a professor at Moscow State University.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.msu.ru/ad/k-yubileyu-yuriya-vladimirovicha-bolotina.html|title=К юбилею Юрия Владимировича Болотина] (On the anniversary of Yuri Vladimirovich Bolotin)|website=МГУ, официальный сайт, 1 декабря 2014 года (МГУ Moscow State University, official site)|date=1 December 2014}}</ref> Both brothers in 2020 became champions of Russia in the class of yachts "Carter 30".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fpsmo.ru/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/OficialnYe-rezultatY-3.pdf|title=Чемпионат России по парусному спорту в классе "Крейсеркая яхта "Картер 30" (Russian sailing championship in the class "Cruising yacht" Carter 30)|website=Официальный сайт Федерации парусного спорта Московской области, сентябрь 2020 года (Official site of the Sailing Federation of the Moscow Region)|date=September 2020}}</ref>
